name: OpenFOAM campaign: a jet into a trough, six runs
description: The base case of make_base.py (6 m 2-D trough, liquid bath, inclined jet, interFoam with k-omega SST) and the six runs of plan.json (jet speed 2-3 m/s, angle 50-70 degrees), each with its solver health and the k / alpha profile on the mid-depth line averaged from 2 s (examples/openfoam_campaign).
